title: Finite reduction of a fixed-point stalk identification
statement:
Fix primes $p\ne\ell$, an integer $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, $k_0=\mathbf F_q$ and an algebraic closure $k$ of $k_0$. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and integers $N\geq j\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^N$ and $B=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^j$, with the quotient map $A\to B$. Let $X_0$ be a separated finite-type $k_0$-scheme, $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, with the constant-coefficient small pro-etale derived categories and $D^b_{ctf}$ conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. For a complex $M$ write $rM=M\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B$, using derived change of rings [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Let $h:X\to X$ be a $k$-endomorphism and let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$. Write $Lh_A^*$ and $Lh_B^*$ for derived pullback at the two coefficient rings [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and $\mu_{h,K}:r(Lh_A^*K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh_B^*(rK)$ for the canonical coefficient/pullback comparison of [lem-fix-operation-reduction].

Let $\bar y:t=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to X$ be a geometric point, with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], and suppose the scheme maps satisfy $h\circ\bar y=\bar y$. Set
$$
S_R(M)=\Gamma\bigl(t,L\bar y_R^*M\bigr)\in D(R),\qquad R=A,B,
$$
using exact derived sections at the algebraically closed point [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact]. Let
$$
\iota_{h,R,M}:S_R(M)\xrightarrow{\sim}S_R(Lh_R^*M)
$$
be sections of the pullback-composition isomorphism $L(h\circ\bar y)_R^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}L\bar y_R^*Lh_R^*M$ of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], with its source identified with $L\bar y_R^*M$ using $h\circ\bar y=\bar y$.
For $M\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ let $\sigma_M:rS_A(M)\xrightarrow{\sim}S_B(rM)$ be the point-sections reduction isomorphism [lem-trf-point-sections-finite-reduction] followed by sections of the coefficient/pullback comparison for $\bar y$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Since $Lh_A^*K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ by clause (i) of [thm-sf-ctf-stability], $\sigma_{Lh_A^*K}$ is defined; set $\widetilde\sigma_K=S_B(\mu_{h,K})\circ\sigma_{Lh_A^*K}$. Then
$$
\widetilde\sigma_K\circ r(\iota_{h,A,K})=\iota_{h,B,rK}\circ\sigma_K
\quad\text{in }D(B).
$$
This identity is natural in $K$ and assumes no Weil structure, no coefficient endomorphism and no properness of $h$.

source.place: Proof (3), last sentence: iota_K is built from composition isomorphisms for Phi^m composed with the geometric point equal to that point, and geometric-point pullback is monoidal; hence the stalk operators reduce.
